message:
Hi Jimena
I’m looking for layout and design support for a response (proposal) to an RFP. There would be strict rules around the file size, page numbers, etc. There will also be the reality of the turnaround time being last-minute because of the nature of RFP timelines. Although I suspect the RFP will come out this month. 1) Do you have experience with this type of proposal support? 2) If so, how do you prepare for these types of timelines w/ clients,what if edits are needed from clients until its final?

Hi Tiffany,

Yes, I regularly support RFP responses with strict compliance requirements, such as page limits, file size restrictions, formatting rules, and tight turnaround timelines. This is the core of my design work over the last 15+ years.

My approach is built for condensed timelines:
• Once the RFP is released, I set up a compliant template immediately and confirm all technical requirements (margins, fonts, file size, submission details, etc.)
• I align to your internal workplan and review schedule, with built-in flexibility for rolling edits
• I keep my schedule clear for the final 48–72 hours to focus exclusively on redline reviews, last-minute content drops, QA/QC, and final PDF optimization

I've managed this process many times. I know how to stay calm under pressure and deliver a polished, compliant submission on deadline.

I'd be happy to have a call to discuss your specific RFP and my qualifications to support your team.

Best regards,
Jimena

This is music to my ears! Thank you, Jimena.

I’ll get back to you later tonight or tomorrow with date options for a call.

Thanks again, and until then!

I’m currently free any time from 1-3pm tomorrow \(Monday, 1/5\). Any chance you’re available during this window? Also the other team members I’m partnering with may want to join the call as well. Just a heads up. Thanks!

Good morning! That’s perfect. 1–3pm CST today works for me. Happy to have anyone from your team join the call.

If there’s any material you’d like me to review in advance, feel free to send it over.

I’ll share the meeting scheduler through Upwork.
Good morning! I should have specified that I meant ET, not CST. Also, can you confirm there isn't a fee for our call? I'll pick a time in the interim. Thank you!

Time is perfect! And no fee for the call.

Talk to you soon.
Great! Thank you!
Thank you for your time today. I really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about your upcoming proposal. I think we’d work well together and I’m looking forward to what’s next.

Thank you, Jimena! Same to you. I just looked at the current proposal. The full document is 83 pages, including all letters, forms, etc. Out of the 83 pages, there are 55 pages that have a graphic touch. Would you be able to give me an approximate budget (range) for your support on the project? Also. can you include a budget with 1 simple infographic and 1 simple map plus another budget without these items? Thank you!

Perfect, that really helps!

For this type of proposal design work with a custom design, I typically budget between 1 to 1.5 hours per page. That covers layout and graphic treatment across the 55 design-focused pages and includes all meetings, revisions, on-demand support during the final 48 hours before submission, final delivery of the full document, and general proposal support throughout the process.

Based on that approach, here are the two budget options you requested:
\- Without infographic and map: $3,800–$4,500
\- With 1 simple infographic and 1 simple map: $4,100–$4,800

I’m happy to proceed on either a fixed-fee basis or hourly, depending on what works best for you. Let me know if that was in the ballpark of what you were imagining. I'm open to adjusting based on your feedback.
Got it! Thank you, Jimena. I'll discuss with the rest of the team and get back to you (hopefully by the end of the week).
Wonderful, have a great week!

Hi Tiffany, just following up on your note from last week. I wanted to see if the team had a chance to discuss and if you had any questions from your end.

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thank you,
Jimena

Hi! Thanks for checking in. I recommended you as my #1 to the team. The lead had trouble seeing your profile on his end. I’m hoping he can troubleshoot on his end soon so he can confirm interest in working with you. Will let you know once I hear from him. Thanks for your patience. PS The RFP hasn’t posted yet. Fingers crossed it gets published this month!

Hi Tiffany, thanks so much for the update. I really appreciate you recommending me to the team!

Here's my profile link in case it helps with access on his end:
<https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/jimenac11?viewMode=1>

I'm also happy to schedule a call with the team lead if he has any questions.

Quick availability update for planning: I'm fully available throughout the rest of January and February. I'll be away from March 4 to 16 for a family trip (celebrating my mom's 70th birthday!), so I won’t be able to provide active support during that window.

If the RFP posts this month as expected, the timing should work perfectly. Happy to stay flexible as things develop.

Thanks again, and looking forward to connecting soon.

Best,
Jimena

Good morning Jimena - TPEC (engineering firm) wants to move forward with you. They're going to ask you to sign an NDA, heads up. Once we've got that squared away, I can share the previous proposal and supporting docs., so that you can get started on the layout, branding, resumes, etc. Note that the RFP hasn't been posted yet, so we're trying to just get ready to go in the interim. Thanks!

Hi Tiffany,

That's great news! No problem at all signing an NDA.

I can set up the contract in Upwork once you let me know your preference:
\- Hourly: $86.00/hr, billed automatically on a weekly basis (offers flexibility if scope changes)
\- Fixed rate: $4,500, paid in three milestones, contract start, first draft, and final submission (predictable budget)

*Just a quick reminder from my earlier note: I'll be away from my computer March 4–16.*

Let me know what works best!

Thanks,
Jimena

Hi Jimena - Andrew Chiang (TPEC) may be reaching out to you to get started with the contract today. He represents the engineering firm I'm partnering with on the proposal. I'll be your primary contact for the proposal but Andrew is critical for payment/admin. I'll also pass along your hourly vs fixed rate option to the firm now. Thanks!
Sounds good and thanks for the heads up. I’ll keep an eye out for Andrew’s message so we can get the Upwork contract set up.
By the way, can you confirm that we'll get the raw files and the PDF, etc. of the final files?
Yes, absolutely. Final PDFs and all original design files.
Excellent! Also, we have a template from the last time we submitted, and there may not be a need for maps, infographics, etc. So it may be fewer hours of work ( lower than $4500).
We'll have more clarity once that RFP is posted.

That makes sense. If we're reusing a previous template, there may not be a need for maps or infographics.

It would be helpful to review the previous submission as part of the kickoff meeting so we can discuss design direction, what needs to be updated/what can be used as is. It's more difficult for me to assess effort without seeing existing materials.

I'm planning to send you the proposal and a reference doc as soon as the contract is final. I'd like for you to get started with the layout, branding, etc. ASAP, so hopefully you'll hear from Andrew today.
\*and I'll let you know as soon as I hear from them on the rate structure
Awesome, I'll be online till 5pm EST.
Jimena - See attached NDA from TPEC. Thanks!
Could this be shared as a PDF?
Are you able to share your email address? I can forward the original version to you.
Or I can PDF it shortly.
It's against the Upwork policy to share emails before the contract is established. Regretfully, it will flag and remove the info.
No worries! I just PDF'd it.
Let me know if that's better. If not, I can ask the original source for the PDF version
Thats perfect. Will review and share back today.
Great! Thanks.
Here is the signed version.
Thank you!!

Hi Jimena! I’m planning to respond to an RFQ \(separate from the Tpec project\). It should be pretty straightforward - packaging of all content into one doc., layout, org. chart, budget sheet, and formatting. The response is due 7/31 but I’m planning to submit 7/30. Are you interested in helping me with this task? If so, can you provide me with the total cost? Also I’ll send the RFQ shortly so that you can reference it. Thanks!
<https://www.greenlatinos.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/07.02_UFCommunications_Final.pdf>
Here’s the RFQ.⬆️
Hi Tiffany, thank you so much for thinking of me for this response. I reviewed the RFP you shared, and I agree that the submission looks pretty straightforward.
Based on the requirements, I estimate the response will be around 20–25 pages, depending on the team. Does that sound accurate from your side?
That sounds about right. Since it's an RFQ, and not an RFP, I'm thinking it may be slightly shorter, so perhaps up to 20 pages.

Thanks for the additional detail, it helps me get a better understanding of the scope.

Based on the RFQ and anticipated page count, my fee for this project would be $2,400. This includes:
\- Creative direction and proposal design
\- Layout and graphic treatment of the full document
\- Development of a cohesive visual theme aligned with the RFQ and client
\- Integration of graphics, photos, tables, and other visual elements as needed
\- Meetings, revisions, and support throughout the process, including on-demand help leading up to submission
\- Final production and delivery of the complete proposal package

If this works for you, I'll send over a proposed contract via Upwork, and we can set up a short kickoff call to align on timeline, proposal strategy, and design direction.

Unfortunately, that's outside of my budget and feels like too much scope. Can we come up with a simpler version? A single formatting/layout pass on the final draft, using GreenLatinos' existing brand colors and fonts, with one round of revisions, delivered as a print-ready PDF? So I'm thinking what I really need is 1) layout and graphic treatment of the full doc. and 2) Integration of tables/photos/org chart/graphics applied to final draft. Also I'm guessing there's a chance that an RFP may come later given that the RFQ is usually the first step. What would this updated version cost?

Happy to adjust to your needs. For a single formatting/layout pass on the final draft, using GreenLatinos' existing brand colors and fonts, with one round of revisions, my fee would be $1,400.

This would include:
\- Layout and graphic treatment of the full document
\- Integration of tables, photos, org chart, and other graphics into the final draft
\- One round of revisions
\- Delivery as a print-ready PDF and Canva design link

A few things to note:
\- To keep this timeline and budget on track, I'd prefer to receive all final content shared at once (text, tables, photos, org chart, and any other supporting materials).
\- I'll need three business days to turn around the first draft and two days for the revision
\- The layout will be created in Canva, so you or your team can make any final content edits if needed after the revision round.

Thank you for sending over the $1400.00 estimate. This works for me.

A few things -

1) My subcontractors won’t have content to me until EOD next Wednesday, which is going to compress your working window. Would a 48-hour turnaround from when I send you the final narrative content be workable + a 24-hour turnaround for final revisions on your end?

2) Regarding branding, I’ve changed it from the client to the bidder (me!). I’d like it to be designed for my company’s identity, Agua Arc. I have a logo and colors I can share with you.

3) This is going to be the first proposal that I submit as a prime (I just launched my company less than a year ago, and I’m solo), so I’d like to treat this proposal as a template moving forward. I’d love for the template that you create to be built with swappable/modular sections so I don't have to rebuild proposals from scratch in the future. Specifically, I’m thinking a) a flexible narrative section structure (e.g., some proposals have 5 sections v 8 sections), b) a modular table style that can resize for different budget structures, and c) a “prepared for \_\_\_ \[client name\]” credit line rather than client branding.

4) Canva - Will I be able to have ownership of the files if I don’t have a paid subscription? Are there other source files or would it all be solely in Canva?

Thank you!
Congratulations on launching Agua Arc, exciting to be part of your first proposal as a prime!

1) That schedule works on my end. To confirm dates: I'd be working Thursday the 24th and Friday the 25th on the first draft, then Tuesday the 28th for revisions.

2) Happy to design this around Agua Arc's identity instead of GreenLatinos. Please share your logo, colors and any other content I should reference.

3) The modular template system you're describing is a great idea for your business long-term, but it's a different scope than what was quoted. Building something that flexes across future proposals with varying section counts and budget structures takes more design and testing than a single-use layout pass. I'd love to help you build that out, but I want to price it separately so it's fair to both of us. Would you like a quote for the modular template as an add-on now, or would you rather keep this first proposal simple and revisit the template as its own project afterward?

4) I'll use free Canva assets throughout, so there won't be any Pro-only elements tied to the file. Once it's built, I'll share it with you with full edit access. You'll own it and be able to reuse/adapt it independently for future proposals. such as swapping in different client info, content, and project details.
Thank you on the congrats! :)

1) Clarifying the schedule - the other team members aren't sending me their info until EOD Wed, so I'll need to write the whole thing on Thursday/Friday. I was hoping I could get you the first draft by early morning on Monday, 7/27, so you work on it Monday and Tuesday, and then I do my review, and you make final edits on Wed or Thurs, and then I would submit late Thursday night. Eek! The deadline is Friday 7/31, so technically I can submit then, but would prefer to do it before, if possible. I know this is tight, so let me know if you think it could work on your end.
2) Happy to hear you can design it with my Agua Arc brand! Exciting. :)

3) I understand. Let's keep this first proposal simple for now then, and revisit the template in the future. Can you confirm that I can still do edits in Canva though? Just in case I need to do anything last-minute after your final review.
4) Your last point seems to confirm my concern in #3. 🙌 Thank you!

That timeline works on my end. Depending on when your content lands Monday (7/27), I may need until early Wednesday to get you the first draft ready. That would still leave you room for your review and my final edits before a late Thursday submission.

In the meantime, if you're able to send over your branding documents, I can get the cover page, table of contents, and general layout set up in anticipation of the content.

I'll share the proposed contract for your review.
All that sounds good! Thank you for being so flexible!
I'll finalize the contract now and then follow up with the branding details.
Branding related files uploaded. Let me know if you need anything else. Thank you!
Hi! Quick note to let you know I have a skeleton for the document. If it helps to have it early, I can send it to you. Thanks and have a great weekend!
Hi Tiffany, we are all set with the contract. Thank you!
Please go ahead and share the skeleton of the document; that will be helpful as I get some of the backbone design in place.

Hi! Thanks, and I'm going to attach the skeleton now. Two notes to keep in mind - 1) the section order is fixed by the client's Q&A (which came out Friday night) and cannot be redesigned , so we need to stick to the order in this skeleton, and 2) the final deliverable is one PDF submitted by email, so the template should be built for clean PDF export that is "emailable" (not sure if I mentioned this before). Thank you!
Perfect, and yes I understand. The PDF will be compressed for email.
Great! Thank you!

Hola! I know you're planning to work with all of the content at once. However, I'm going to drop a file and a note here now, so I don't forget later. I understand if you don't review it until you have everything. I'm still planning to get you everything by Monday morning, at the latest.

1) Here's a folder of photos to drop in to the document. The photos I definitely want to see in the doc are the ones with asterisks in the title. <https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1szjFlikXpov--PRj6U6esXJaZ8az8VAk?usp=sharing>
Confirming receipt. Looking forward to receiving the rest tomorrow.
Thank you for confirming receipt! I'm looking forward to wrapping this up and getting it into your hands, too! Until then.
Dropping another note here now, so I don't forget later. I'll enumerate the comments to help you stay organized.

2) There are a lot of hyperlinks in the proposal. It will be critical that they function. Noting this here because I want to make sure that when the final file is saved, the hyperlinks will work. Thanks!
3) Another note - please make sure fonts are consistent (same types in the appropriate sections and the appropriate size).
Good morning! Quick note to let you know that the doc will be in your hands by 9 a.m. Talk more then!
<https://docs.google.com/document/d/12H4VHyGnBTOH9uiDKRQrDUHnPbxsFCFDRCQXaggGPjU/edit?usp=sharing>
Just emailed you the link to the doc, and posted it above.
It looks long but I think it's because of all of the spacing. Hopefully you can get it to fit within the page limit. If not, let me know.
Also, I'm still working on a few details (highlighted in yellow/red). Hoping I can easily update those detaila in Canva
I'm going into a meeting momentarily, but I'll be available after 12 p.m. (E.T.), if you have questions about anything.
THANK YOU!!!!!
PS Please confirm receipt and access to doc.
Good morning Tiffany, confirming receipt. I was able to access the Google docs without any problems. Will let you know if I have questions as I start working through the design.
perfect! thanks1

Hi! One of the contractors just sent me 4 resumes to add to the proposal. I wasn't expecting there to be more team members. This means I need to make 4 more bios to add to the Appendix, under Message Agency. Hoping you can add a placeholder for these 4 bios and I can drop them in when I do my review. thanks.
Understood, will create placeholders for the bios.
Thank you!

Jimena - I need to replace two tables in the proposal. I'm sorry about this. They're in this doc. I hope you haven't gotten to this part of the layout. If you have, I hope it's not too much of an inconvenience to replace the two tables. Thank you. <https://docs.google.com/document/d/17GcO5aSlka6lfvcDmgZsdDsh0t8aMqpv8VXz0Q8Px8I/edit?usp=sharing>
I just dropped the new bios in the Tables doc too, just in case you're able to drop these in too, rather than the placeholders. Thank you!!

Good morning Tiffany, quick update - I’m about halfway through the design and will make sure to use the updated tables and bios you shared.

The document is almost twice the length outlined in the initial scope. Given the additional content, my design approach is to keep the proposal clean, organized, and easy to navigate without adding too much visual complexity.

The final design will be a bit more streamlined, with more consistent layouts and fewer custom treatments per section, so the focus stays on the content and the overall flow of the proposal. I’ll continue working through the remaining pages and will keep you posted as I make progress.

Good morning!

This works for me. Thank you.

I didn’t realize how long it would get but hoping the spacing in between sections and paragraphs can get reduced to get closer to our original page limit.

I’m also hoping to reduce the letter \(first page\) to one page when I get to the review.

If there’s anything else that’s awkward, I can try to reduce the content further during my review, if it helps.

Thank you for working with me on this and for keeping me posted on your progress.

Hi Tiffany,

Attached is the first draft of the proposal, and here's the Canva link - <https://canva.link/pj6c20va7w0ezec>

A few notes as you review:

\- **General design:** Since the document ended up being nearly twice the original length and we were working on a tight timeline, I focused on creating a consistent design system rather than introducing a lot of unique layouts. That should also make any revisions easier to manage.

\- **Graphics & photos:** I used organic-shaped image frames and a few subtle graphic elements that felt like a good fit for the overall theme without competing with the content.

\- **Section 6: Prioritization:** This section wasn't included in the updated tables document, so I wasn't sure if it should still be part of the proposal.

\- **In-text bolding:** I got a little confused about what was intended to be bolded. The Google Doc had some text highlighted and some in red, and once I got into the layout I wasn't sure which formatting was intentional versus editorial markup.

**\- Links:** I tested all of the hyperlinks and they appear to be working, but it would be great if a second reviewer could click through them as well.

\- **Final review:** This was a pretty tight turnaround, so I'll also be doing another pass tomorrow with fresh eyes to catch anything I may have missed, but I wanted to get this to you today.

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts. Hopefully we're in a good place, and I can fine-tune anything you'd like to adjust after your review.

Jimena - This is absolutely beautiful! I LOVE IT! I especially love how you set up the work samples with icons, and how organized everything looks in the appendix. The little details from my logo under the pics look great too. :)

I'm going to drop my comments in here now, so you can think about it before you go in for the final edits. In the meantime, I will start to update the content in the Canva version. I'll let you know when my edits are final, likely not until tomorrow afternoon.

1) The cover/TOC/Page Divider for Appendix and Last Page - I don't love the light pink/cream wash in the background on these pages. Do you have another idea for this? If not, I think maybe we just go with white like the rest of the doc.

2) The letter is going to be one page and I need to add my signature. Hopefully I can do this smoothly in Canva, but note that the two pages currently on the second page of the letter are two of my favorites for this proposal, so I'm hoping you can move them to another section, if they don't fit on the one-page version of the letter.
3) Page 15 - Can we make the tree more visible in the pic? Maybe zoom out?
4) Page 19 - remove pic of boy in white t-shirt in front of garden. you can either replace the photo with another one or just leave one pic on the page
5) Page 24 - Can we show more of the tree in the pic with the lady?
6) Page 30 - Can we show the full tree in this photo too?
I don't have any other comments at this time. I'll let you know tomorrow by EOD if I have any other comments then. Thank you again!

Hi Tiffany,

I took care of these edits.

1) Removed the cream wash, now they are white like the remainder of the document
2) Letter - addressed the comment in Canva and moved the images to pg. 18
3) Recropped to show more tree
4) Images removed and replaced with one from the cover letter
5) Recropped to show more tree
5) Recropped to show more tree
Wonderful! Thank you. I'll let you know if I have more edits/comments tomorrow, and will continue to add comments directly to the doc, if it helps too.

Good morning! I'm continuing to work thru the edits directly in Canva. I wanted to let you know that I just realized the master doc I gave you had a subsection missing from it for Section 2. I noted it in the comments in Canva, but I'm sharing it with you here so you have quick access to the content that needs to go in. My apologies for missing this earlier. <https://docs.google.com/document/d/17GcO5aSlka6lfvcDmgZsdDsh0t8aMqpv8VXz0Q8Px8I/edit?usp=sharing>

Hi Tiffany,

Thank you. I’m receiving the comments, and I’ll address them all together for the v2. Please let me know when you’re finished. I’m thinking I'll most likely be working on it tomorrow morning.

Best,
Jimena
Will do! My goal is to be done by EOD today. So your plan of working on it tomorrow morning sounds good. Thanks!

Jimena - Unfortunately, I had to add two rows per phase in the Payment and Milestone Schedule table. I've dropped the revised version of the table in the Google doc shared earlier today. Not sure if it's easier for you to add two rows per phase to add in teh additions or to replace the whole thing. Please let me know if you have any questions when you get to this revision. Thanks.
Alright, I'm done on my end! I've checked all hyperlinks. All worked!
I had to add some missing content that I realized today didn't transfer over previously. I'm sorry about.
All of my comments are in the doc. If there's something that's not clear, don't hesitate to reach out. Thank you for all of your beautiful work, and for working with me on this crazy timeline.
Perfect, I will have v2 to you tomorrow. I will reach out if I have any questions.
Great, thank you!!

Good morning, Tiffany -

Attached is GreenLatinos RFQ Response v2. You can access the editable document using the same Canva link: <https://canva.link/pj6c20va7w0ezec>

I've addressed all of the comments I was tagged in and updated the table of contents.

I'll be away from my computer for the next few hours and back this evening in case there are any minor edits that you're not able to make on your own.
Wonderful! Thank you for the quick turnaround. I'll be in meetings for a while but will do one last full read this afternoon, and let you know if I need any additional support then.👍

Jimena - I'm reviewing a little bit in between meetings, and will drop anything that's off here. 1) We lost the view of the tree in the photo on page 11. Hoping you can zoom out a bit so the tree is slightly more visible again. Thanks.

Hi! Still working through my review, but my goal is to be done by 6:30pm. I've made a few minor tweaks to words that haven't impacted formatting. However, there are a few outsanding items (formatting) that still need to be resolved from yesterday. They're very minor, like the above photo, but I wanted to give you a heads up. They're noted in the Comments in the current version.Thanks and I'll let you know when I'm completely done.
Hi Tiffany, sounds good. I just resolved the last 3 comments and adjusted the image. I’ll check back in after 6:30pm to see if anything else needs to be done.
thanks
I'm done! Please let me know when you're done with finalizing this version (any outstanding issues that didn't get resolved yesterday, and then saved as a final PDF that is "emailable." Thank you!
PS I'm still planning on emailing the doc to GL today. Thanks.
There were no open comments, so I exported it with the digital distribution settings Canva offers. It is well below the 25mb file size standard limit.
Fantastic! I’m going to review this version’s hyperlinks and then send it. Will circle back after.
Hope it’s all good!

Everything worked! I just emailed the submission to GL, and they confirmed receipt. WAHOOO! Thank you so much for your partnership in this process. Your work is beautiful, and you were the ultimate professional, staying on schedule (and moving things even earlier than expected). I'm looking forward to telling TPEC about how great you were to work with on this product! I'll also keep you in mind if any other proposals come up in the future, and will certainly refer you to other colleagues. I'll plan to submit a review on Upwork too. MIL GRACIAS DE NUEVO!!! :)
Just realized I hadn’t released the payment. I think it went through now. Sorry about the delay. Thanks again!.

Thank you so much, it was a pleasure working with you too! Your organization and communication really made the whole process go very smoothly on my end.

I'm glad everything was submitted successfully, and I'm looking forward to picking the TPEC work back up later this year.

Thanks as well for releasing the payment. And for leaving an Upwork review, as you know, it really makes a difference.

Have a great weekend, and I'll look forward to working together again!
